title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Estuary
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Estuary. An estuary is a partially enclosed coastal body of brackish water with one or more rivers or streams flowing into it, and with a free connection to the open sea. Subclass of SinkAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the SinkAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Estuary'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: Geoproperty. Geojson reference to the item. Maps to geo:hasGeometry in the SAREF4WATR/GeoSPARQL ontology.
